name: Estimate PBR Properties (Project Candidate)
author: Modly
description: Estimates supported PBR channels from calibrated RGB views using unchanged geometry, exact topology correspondence, and validated material-region assignments. CPU candidate; quality and AMD gates remain open.

params_schema.label: Calibrated observation bundle
params_schema.tooltip: Workspace-relative JSON bundle containing calibrated training lights, source-observation identities, and a topology-bound CPU array archive. Missing or uncalibrated evidence fails closed.

params_schema.label: UV map resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Output UV map resolution for the provisional estimator.

params_schema.label: Base-color region prior
params_schema.tooltip: Strength of the within-region base-color prior. Zero disables it; values and estimator identity are recorded in stage provenance.
